thread:
sam.ae: Hey team — presales call with FinRegCo tomorrow. They want EU-only data residency for the POC and need a list of subprocessors + our routing/failover policy. Can infra/legal confirm what we can commit to for a 30-day POC?
chloe.se: Do they require BYOK or just EU KMS? Their RFP said 'customer-controlled keys' but wasn't explicit.
linh-legal: If BYOK, we'll need the BYOK addendum and subprocessors enumerated by legal entity (not just cloud regions). Also confirm whether logs are included in the residency scope.
mike-infra: For hosted POC we can pin the tenant to eu-west-1 or eu-central-1. Standard routing: pin -> regional failover -> global only on catastrophic outage. For POC we can enforce no global failover.
chloe.se: Can you paste the minimal routing config we give customers?
mike-infra: Sure — example config we ship for an EU-only POC: ```json
{"routing_policy":"pin","preferred_regions":["eu-west-1"],"failover":"none","subprocessors":["aws:eu-west-1","gcp:europe-west2"]}
```
tara-privacy: Note: legal wants subprocessors by vendor legal name + country. I can take the cloud-to-legal-entity mapping.
sam.ae: The customer also asked about egress billing if failover to APAC ever happens during testing. For POC we need a clear statement.
chloe.se: Our presales playbook: absorb up to 100GB cross-region egress for POC; beyond that pass-through. We document in SOW. @mike-infra any infra constraints?
mike-infra: That policy works. Technically we can quarantine traffic and metrics to keep logs in-region. KV cache and ephemeral model state remain in-region for pinned tenants. Cross-region backups only if explicitly enabled.
customer-it: Quick Q from their security team: will auditor logs or application logs ever replicate outside EU (e.g., to US for analytics)? They require 'no cross-border log transfer' during the POC.
mike-infra: By default we don't replicate logs cross-border. Our backups may be replicated only if you opt into global backup. For the POC we'll disable cross-region backups and turn off analytics export.
linh-legal: I'll prepare the subprocessors & BYOK addendum draft; need the exact infra mapping (service -> vendor legal name -> country). @mike-infra can you provide?
mike-infra: Attaching mapping in a follow-up, but short list: AWS Europe (Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL, Luxembourg), GCP Europe (Google Cloud Europe Limited, Ireland). We also use Cloud Logging (same legal entity) and our telemetry pipeline (Redwood telemetry - EU tenant-only).
chloe.se: Also flagging KMS flow: for BYOK we require customer to upload key material through our onboarding portal; once keys are registered it takes ~48-72h to enable BYOK for a new tenant.
devops-bot: Deploy queued: enable-tenant-byo-kms eu-west-1 -> ETA 2024-06-03T10:15:00Z :white_check_mark:
sam.ae: Perfect. I'll summarize: 1) EU-only pinning (no failover) for the POC, 2) BYOK optional — ETA 48-72h to enable once keys provided, 3) subprocessors list and legal entities incoming from infra/legal, 4) POC egress: 100GB included then pass-through. Please confirm in-thread so I can update SOW and security questionnaire response.
chloe.se: Confirmed from my side.
linh-legal: Confirmed - I'll send the addendum + subprocessors doc by EOD.
tara-privacy: I'll validate the SCA items and ensure 'no cross-border logs' is enforced in the tenant config.
customer-it: Thanks all — we'll share BYOK instructions if we proceed.
sam.ae: Thanks everyone — I'll prep the email to FinRegCo and attach the SOW draft and the drive link for their SQ: https://drive.redwood/finregco-poc-sq
chloe.se: Ping me if they ask for any SLA penalties for residency breach; we'll route that to legal. :thumbsup:
